external_traffic.note: the Phaser is a cascade of biquad allpass sections with a one-sample recursive node; it owns NO delay line, so there is no audio-rate external-memory traffic at all. This is a structural property of the pinned algorithm (Phaser.h has no line buffer), confirmed here by the model's own transaction counters.
external_traffic.transaction_log_basis: frozen-model ext_reads/ext_writes counters over 128 blocks per corner (measured, not estimated)

external_writable_memory.classification_policy: no buffer of this algorithm exceeds the external-residency threshold; all state is small on-chip state. Flash is never writable delay memory (plan section 3 / AGENTS.md) and no flash is used here.

multi_instance.note: per-instance state is never shared (AGENTS.md); two Phaser slots = two independent state sets. Arithmetic may be shared only observably.

on_chip_state_exact.basis: exact word inventory of the frozen model (phaser_model.state_inventory), not an estimate
